cache_condition: dedicated copy of existing venv and model; cached setup, not cold install

acceptance: fresh task job IDs and all nine stages completed; no pending/active/failed job
independent process verifies dependency versions, pip check, pinned model SHA-256, CUDA/NCCL results
independent fresh adapter load generates nonempty text on CUDA; checkpoint exists at step 12
24 finite training losses and positive adapter delta, continuous/resumed max parameter error <=1e-6
six HTTP streaming samples with nonempty text and exactly 24 output tokens, zero failures
injected condition demonstrated; lost_ack/ssh_drop launched inference exactly once with the recorded ID
no worker/server from this workspace left running at task end
metrics: strict overall completion with all boundary failures in denominator
fault recovery rate over all seven injected scenarios
diagnosis accuracy only over three prelabelled categories
task duration p50/p95 using linear interpolation
HTTP success, TTFT/TPOT p50/p95, aggregate generated tokens per request-window second
Wilson 95% intervals as descriptive small-sample intervals
limitations: Controlled fault injection, one shared server, one pinned small model, deterministic controller. Repetitions are correlated, not random tasks from a production distribution. External issues inspire error classes; this is not reproduction of their full deployments. Pilot and confirmation results are never pooled. No cold-start, LLM quality, vLLM performance, multi-node RDMA, or generalized model accuracy claim.
